name: Carasso Real Estate
summary: Operating within Israel, Carasso Real Estate Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive spectrum of real estate endeavors, spanning from initial planning and strategic investment to development and construction. Their diverse portfolio encompasses a wide array of property types, including office high-rises, industrial parks, retail centers, residential complexes, vehicle-related facilities, and distribution hubs. These ventures are primarily concentrated in significant Israeli areas such as Petach Tikva, Rishon Lezion, Beersheva, and Rehovoth. Established in 1967, the firm maintains its headquarters in Tel Aviv, Israel, and functions as a subsidiary under the umbrella of The Carasso Group.
